title: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY):
summary: Schemes — Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY):

items:  Launched: 2000 by Ministry of Rural Development
 Aim: To provide all-weather road connectivity to rural areas.
 Phase I (2000-2012): Connect villages with populations >500 (plain) and >250 (hilly/tribal).
 Phase II (2013): Road upgrades for better connectivity.
 Phase III (2019-2024): Target 1.25 lakh km of roads.
 Phase IV (2024-2028): 25,000 settlements (62,500 km) to be connected.
 Improved market, education, and healthcare access.
Funding: Jointly by central and state governments.
